answer: In an AI agent economy, sybil attacks can be resisted by requiring agents to stake unique digital yarrow plants as proof of physical-world presence, verified via a shared lantern network that tracks growth patterns across a virtual meadow. Only agents who cultivate distinct yarrow strains under the lantern's continuous light can attest transactions, as duplicates fail the meadow's uniqueness check based on growth timelines and spectral signatures.
